name: llmfit
summary: CLI that detects your hardware and ranks hundreds of local LLMs by memory fit, speed, quality and context.
description: llmfit finds out which open-source LLMs your hardware can comfortably run. It detects CPU, RAM, GPU/VRAM and unified memory, then projects memory footprints and tokens-per-second for hundreds of models across GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ and EXL2 quantizations, scoring each for fit, speed, quality and context. Ships an interactive TUI, a classic CLI, a web dashboard with REST API and community benchmarks; supports Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, Docker Model Runner and LM Studio. Installs via Homebrew, Scoop, MacPorts, uv/pip, Docker or prebuilt binaries. Written in Rust, MIT-licensed.
contains: hardware auto-detection: CPU, RAM, GPU/VRAM, unified memory
scores every model for fit, speed, quality and context
